units.source_text: 然而这会上的招待人，都选用老成自重、不会轻率嬉笑的人，叫他们拿着壶樽敬酒。

en.t: However, the attendants at this gathering were all chosen from among mature, self-possessed people who would not laugh or jest lightly, and they were made to carry the wine vessels and offer drinks.

units.source_text: 只是儒家的礼仪过分别致，因此右大将和民部卿等虽然谨慎小心地捧着酒爵，终不合法，常被儒学博士严厉指责。

en.t: But Confucian ceremonial rules were excessively intricate, so although the Captain of the Right and the Minister of Popular Affairs held the wine cups with great caution, they still failed to follow the proper form and were repeatedly scolded sternly by the Confucian scholars.

units.source_text: 有一儒学博士骂道：“尔等乃一奉陪之人，何其无礼！

en.t: One Confucian scholar rebuked them, saying, "You are merely attendants here; how can you be so rude!

units.source_text: 某乃著名儒者，尔等在朝为官而不知，无乃太蠢乎！”

en.t: I am a famous Confucian scholar, and for you to serve at court without knowing that is surely far too foolish!"

units.source_text: 众人听了这等语调，都噗嗤地笑出来。

en.t: When everyone heard this tone of speech, they all burst out laughing.
The scholar scolded them again, "No making noise!

units.source_text: 此乃非礼之极，应即离座退去！”

en.t: This is the height of discourtesy; you should leave your seats and withdraw at once!"
This manner of threatening them was also very funny.

units.source_text: 不曾见惯此种仪式之人，看了觉得稀奇，心中纳罕。

en.t: Those who were not used to seeing this kind of ceremony found it curious to watch and wondered at it inwardly.

units.source_text: 但大学出身的公卿们，懂得此道，都点头微笑。

en.t: But the court nobles who had come from the university understood these customs, and all nodded and smiled.

units.source_text: 他们看见源氏内大臣崇尚学问，以此道教子，十分赞善，都对他表示无限尊敬。

en.t: Seeing that Genji, the Inner Minister, valued learning and taught his son by means of these ways, they praised him highly and showed him boundless respect.
